messages:
Hannah (Marketing): quick creative ask — need a compact set of micro-benchmark visuals for next week's launch: hero diagram (web + print), 2 webinar slides, 1-pager PDF, 3 social tiles (square + story), email header, and an SVG inbound-routing map for HubSpot. Deadline: Tue EOD (2026-04-07). Who can own this?

Maya (Design): I can take it. Can you confirm which metrics and the final short copy? Also need logo guidance & file specs.

Hannah (Marketing): prioritize p50/p95 latency and cost per 1k tokens. Short headlines only — I'll drop copy to Drive. Logos: only whitelist per Legal. Specs: hero web 1400x800, hero print 8.5x11, social 1200x1200 + 1080x1920, email 600x200, SVG must include element ids for mapping.

Ethan (Product): uploaded bench CSV to Drive: p50=45ms, p95=132ms, gen cost=$0.008/1k tokens. Added README: "measured in internal testbeds; not an SLA."

Ops (Marketing Ops): for HubSpot mapping please include element ids like id=form-email id=segment-webinar id=sfdc-lead. I'll provide a mapping CSV after export.

Legal (Legal): compliance note: do not use customer logos without explicit written approval. Partner logos on approved whitelist ok. Avoid definitive SLA-like wording; use "benchmarked" or "measured in our testbeds."

Maya (Design): plan: WIP Mon 09:00 PT (hero + slides first), final assets Tue 15:00 PT. Will export EN masters with editable text layers for FR/DE handoff and an SVG with labeled ids.

Hannah (Marketing): perfect — I'll run a brand-compliance sweep on the WIP and loop Legal if needed. Ping here for any blockers. :thumbsup:
